label: Negation of the occasionalist rival occasionalist mover link without…, by Rival excluded by deeper…
meaning: Conditional refutation of the occasionalist rival STMT-OCCASIONALIST-MOVER-LINK-WITHOUT-CAUSE. If y moves x as moved, then y is distinct from x, moves x in some respect r and is moved by some z in some respect r' (STMT-PER-SE-MOVER-LINK-IS-MOVING-BY-MOVED-MOVER); every mover efficiently causes what it moves in that respect (STMT-MOVER-IS-EFFICIENT-CAUSE), so y efficiently causes x and z efficiently causes y; by the Second Way's per se ordering premise (STMT-SECOND-EFFICIENT-CAUSES-CAUSE-ONLY-AS-CAUSED) y causes x as caused. The occasionalist, for whom the stick is only an occasion, must deny the mover/efficient-cause bridge, not only STMT-PER-SE-MOVER-LINK-IS-PER-SE-CAUSE-LINK. Each premise is needed (STMT-RIVAL-REFUTATIONS-ROUND2-CONTROLS). All three premises are open, so the refutation does not count for closure.
